chunks.arabic_text: وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ يَمْشِي مِنْ خَلْفِ الْمَقَامِ».

translations.en: And it is narrated: “That he walks from behind the Maqam.”
translations.ur: اور یہ روایت ہے: "کہ وہ مقام کے پیچھے سے چلتا ہے۔"
translations.tr: Ve rivayet edilmiştir: "Onun Makam'ın arkasından yürüdüğü."
translations.fa: و روایت شده است: «که او از پشت مقام حرکت می‌کند.»
translations.id: Dan diriwayatkan: "Bahwa dia berjalan dari belakang Maqam."
translations.bn: এবং এটি বর্ণিত হয়েছে: “যে তিনি মাকামের পিছন থেকে হাঁটেন।”
translations.es: Y se narra: “Que él camina por detrás del Maqam.”
translations.fr: Et il est rapporté : « Qu'il marche derrière le Maqam. »
translations.de: Und es wird überliefert: „Dass er hinter dem Maqam geht.“
translations.ru: И передается: «Что он идет сзади Макама.»
translations.zh: 据传：他从麦加姆后面走。

en.summary: This report indicates a legal practice concerning movement in relation to the Maqam of Ibrahim. It points to the prescribed manner of passing or walking from behind the Maqam within the rites being discussed.

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; an impersonal transmission formula indicating a reported narration
key_terms.يَمْشِي: he walks; refers to the prescribed act of moving on foot
key_terms.خَلْفِ: behind; indicates the direction or position relative to something
key_terms.الْمَقَامِ: the Maqam; the Station of Ibrahim in the sacred precinct
